verdict.rationale: Weave documents built-in/custom 'signals' that auto-classify agent behavior and alerts that route via Slack notifications and webhook automations (docs-17, docs-28, docs-36), which could be wired to PagerDuty via webhook, but there's no explicit documentation of PagerDuty or email as native notification channels, nor explicit alert rules tied specifically to error-rate, cost-spike, or eval-score-drop thresholds. missing for 10: native PagerDuty/email integration, explicit configurable alert thresholds on error rate/cost/eval-score, independent confirmation of alerting UX.
